Not every lead deserves your calendar.

When you're running a startup or small business, chasing cold leads drains the energy you need for clients who are actually ready to buy. It’s easy to feel like every email inquiry is gold, but busywork isn't the same as business growth.

So how do you spot the ones truly worth your time? Look for three simple signs: they have a specific problem they can clearly describe, they engage promptly, and they don't vanish the second budget enters the conversation. If they're just browsing, that's okay—give them helpful resources, but don't spend hours on custom proposals.

Setting up simple automations to score and filter intent early lets you focus on real, warm conversations that actually move the needle.

What’s your biggest green flag when talking to a new prospective client? Drop it below!
instagram_text:
Stop chasing every single lead. 👋

Your time is your most valuable asset. If an inquiry takes a week to reply, dodges budget questions, or isn't sure what they actually need, step back. The right leads bring clear problems, real timelines, and quick responses.

A few simple automated filters can help you spot the keepers instantly—saving your energy for the clients who are ready to say yes. ✨
